accounting: Every CLI invocation, failed page request, pagination expansion, native fallback, saved parent envelope, worker saved-brief read and original selected-skill read is charged. CLI request bytes use words separated by one space, a final newline, and stdin. Native-read request bytes use literal read_file <absolute path> followed by newline. Responses are actual returned UTF-8 bytes, including stderr. Native request lengths vary with temporary fixture paths.
cache: cache-hits/op counts local rendered-artifact collection reuse only; no provider cache claim. These single-workflow rows start with fresh fixtures.
limitations: Three one-iteration rows are operation/byte receipts, not statistical timing evidence.
Adversarial complete recovery can cost more bytes than ordinary native output; these receipts do not establish savings.
Native host request serialization is an explicit offline representation, not a particular host JSON protocol or tokenizer.
required_facts: Both arms recover equal needed facts, including final omitted search match, complete long UTF-8 line and byte anchors, buried failure and actual failed:7/unverified outcomes, original assignment/role/skill bodies and authority metadata. Short source uses native reads in both arms.
scope: Deterministic offline CLI/native-read transport replay; no model calls, provider token counts, solver quality claim, or statistically supported speed claim.
